test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The boy kicked the ball high into the air.

options.text: The ball will be kicked high into the air by the boy.
The ball was kicked high into the air by the boy.
The boy kicks the ball high into the air.
The boy had kicked the ball high into the air.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****The ball was kicked high into the air by the boy.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **active voice.** As per the question we have to change it into** passive voice.**
